children: Confidential USDT (cUSDT) is now live on Ethereum, keeping onchain balances encrypted and transfer amounts confidential without any bridging. The token is a confidential version of Tether's USDT, built with Zama's technology, and is designed for payments and yield earning on Morpho. This is Zama's flagship confidential-token product going live on a major chain.

The deployment pairs Zama's encryption technology with Tether's own USDT, giving Zama a direct proof point for its core adoption thesis. It also gives investors a concrete reference as further integrations are considered.
For Ethereum, the benefit is indirect: the network hosts the token, but no token-level consequence for ETH has been stated.
Your balance stays encrypted onchain. Transfer amounts stay confidential.
More ways to use cUSDT, more integrations, and more confidential…

title: Ethereum: Confidential USDT (cUSDT) Goes Live with Encrypted Balances - 21 Sep 2026
